summary: Full scan audit and implementation plan for making all conditional dropdowns and radio controls across the rental application flow (Residency & Housing Status, Previous Residence, Employment & Income, Co-Applicant Method A cards, Co-Applicant Method B self-completion portal, Review Summary, and Admin view) dynamically adapt field visibility, labels, placeholders, bilingual copy, and required validation. Includes end-to-end verification and deployment alongside the already-staged Last-4 SSN updates.
